no_trade.reason: ISRG is a fundamentally elite business with >100% FCF conversion, a fortress balance sheet, and a deep robotic surgery moat. While the ~44x P/E valuation is demanding, the current price ($388.78) lies within the DCF fair value range of $320-$415. Furthermore, the stock is hovering near the lower bound of its established technical range ($378.50). Shorting a high-quality, cash-generating compounder purely on absolute valuation multiples, especially directly into technical support without confirmed fundamental decay, presents structurally poor risk/reward.
no_trade.what_would_reopen: A sustained close outside the current technical range ($378.50-$443.84), or a clear structural deceleration in hospital capital expenditure trends and recurring procedure volumes.
